query:
SELECT date, tpl.1 AS series, tpl.2 AS value
    FROM dbt.api_hopr_gnosisvpn_users_daily
    ARRAY JOIN [
      ('MAU (30d)', toFloat64(active_users_30d)),
      ('WAU (7d)', toFloat64(active_users_7d)),
      ('DAU (1d)', toFloat64(active_users_1d))
    ] AS tpl
    WHERE network = 'jura'
    ORDER BY date, series
